// ==UserScript==
// @name         Notes_OldReact_Pikabu
// @namespace    http://tampermonkey.net/
// @version      1.8
// @description  Комплексный инструмент: личные заметки, цветовые маркеры и возврат старых реакций (ёлка/череп/голубь)
// @author       Strelok13
// @match        *://pikabu.ru/*
// @grant        GM_getValue
// @grant        GM_setValue
// @run-at       document-idle
// ==/UserScript==

/*
 * ФУНКЦИОНАЛ СКРИПТА:
 * 1. Заметки и маркеры: Позволяет ставить до 5 цветовых маркеров пользователю, писать текст и прикреплять ссылки с описаниями.
 * 2. Глобальные настройки: Кнопка ⚙️ в углу экрана для настройки значений цветов (подсказки при наведении).
 * 3. Старые реакции: Заменяет новые SVG-иконки на классические (елка -> какашка, череп -> клоун, голубь -> петух) через Base64.
 * 4. Хранение: Все данные сохраняются локально в менеджере скриптов.
 */

(function() {
    'use strict';

    // База Base64-изображений для замены реакций
    const BASE64_ASSETS = {
        poop_m: "data:image/svg+xml;base64,",
        poop_s: "data:image/svg+xml;base64,",
        clown_m: "data:image/svg+xml;base64,",
        clown_s: "data:image/svg+xml;base64,",
        cock_m: "data:image/svg+xml;base64,",
        cock_s: "data:image/svg+xml;base64,"
    };

    const COLORS = {
        'red': '#e74c3c', 'orange': '#e67e22', 'yellow': '#f1c40f', 'green': '#2ecc71', 
        'blue': '#3498db', 'purple': '#9b59b6', 'pink': '#fd79a8', 'cyan': '#00cec9', 
        'brown': '#d35400', 'gray': '#95a5a6'
    };

    let db = {};
    try {
        db = JSON.parse(GM_getValue('pikabu_notes_db', '{}'));
        for (let user in db) {
            if (db[user].color && !db[user].colors) {
                db[user].colors = [db[user].color];
                delete db[user].color;
            }
            if (!db[user].colors) db[user].colors = [];
            if (db[user].links) {
                db[user].links = db[user].links.map(link => {
                    if (typeof link === 'string') return { url: link, desc: '' };
                    return link;
                });
            }
        }
    } catch(e) { console.error("Notes_OldReact_Pikabu: Ошибка чтения базы", e); }

    let colorDescs = {};
    try { colorDescs = JSON.parse(GM_getValue('pikabu_color_descs', '{}')); } catch(e) {}

    function saveDb() { GM_setValue('pikabu_notes_db', JSON.stringify(db)); }
    function saveColorDescs() { GM_setValue('pikabu_color_descs', JSON.stringify(colorDescs)); }

    function injectReactionReplacements() {
        const getUrl = (key) => BASE64_ASSETS[key] ? `url("${BASE64_ASSETS[key]}")` : 'none';
        const styles = `
            svg.icon--ui-kit__christmastree_m { background-image: ${getUrl('poop_m')} !important; background-position: center !important; background-repeat: no-repeat !important; background-size: contain !important; }
            svg.icon--ui-kit__christmastree_m > * { visibility: hidden !important; }
            svg.icon--ui-kit__christmastree_s { background-image: ${getUrl('poop_s')} !important; background-position: center !important; background-repeat: no-repeat !important; background-size: contain !important; }
            svg.icon--ui-kit__christmastree_s > * { visibility: hidden !important; }
            svg.icon--ui-kit__skull_m { background-image: ${getUrl('clown_m')} !important; background-position: center !important; background-repeat: no-repeat !important; background-size: contain !important; }
            svg.icon--ui-kit__skull_m > * { visibility: hidden !important; }
            svg.icon--ui-kit__skull_s { background-image: ${getUrl('clown_s')} !important; background-position: center !important; background-repeat: no-repeat !important; background-size: contain !important; }
            svg.icon--ui-kit__skull_s > * { visibility: hidden !important; }
            svg.icon--ui-kit__dove_m { background-image: ${getUrl('cock_m')} !important; background-position: center !important; background-repeat: no-repeat !important; background-size: contain !important; }
            svg.icon--ui-kit__dove_m > * { visibility: hidden !important; }
            svg.icon--ui-kit__dove_s { background-image: ${getUrl('cock_s')} !important; background-position: center !important; background-repeat: no-repeat !important; background-size: contain !important; }
            svg.icon--ui-kit__dove_s > * { visibility: hidden !important; }
        `;
        const styleSheet = document.createElement('style');
        styleSheet.type = 'text/css';
        styleSheet.innerText = styles;
        document.head.appendChild(styleSheet);
    }

    function openNoteModal(username) {
        const existingModal = document.getElementById('custom-note-modal');
        if (existingModal) existingModal.remove();
        const existingOverlay = document.getElementById('custom-note-overlay');
        if (existingOverlay) existingOverlay.remove();

        const userData = db[username] || { colors: [], notes: '', links: [] };
        if (!userData.colors) userData.colors = [];
        if (!userData.links) userData.links = [];

        const modal = document.createElement('div');
        modal.id = 'custom-note-modal';
        modal.style.cssText = `position: fixed; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); background: #1e1e1e; color: #fff; padding: 20px; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); z-index: 99999; width: 380px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; border: 1px solid #444;`;

        const header = document.createElement('h3');
        header.innerHTML = `Заметка: <span style="color:#3498db">${username}</span>`;
        header.style.cssText = 'margin-top: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #444; padding-bottom: 10px; font-size: 18px;';
        modal.appendChild(header);

        const colorWrap = document.createElement('div');
        colorWrap.style.cssText = 'display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 15px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center;';
        const renderPalette = () => {
            colorWrap.innerHTML = '';
            Object.keys(COLORS).forEach(c => {
                const isSelected = userData.colors.includes(c);
                const btn = document.createElement('div');
                btn.style.cssText = `width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; background: ${COLORS[c]}; border: 2px solid ${isSelected ? '#fff' : 'transparent'}; transition: 0.2s; box-sizing: border-box;`;
                btn.title = colorDescs[c] ? colorDescs[c] : c;
                btn.onclick = () => {
                    if (userData.colors.includes(c)) userData.colors = userData.colors.filter(color => color !== c);
                    else {
                        if (userData.colors.length >= 5) { alert('Можно выбрать не более 5 маркеров!'); return; }
                        userData.colors.push(c);
                    }
                    renderPalette();
                };
                colorWrap.appendChild(btn);
            });
            const counter = document.createElement('span');
            counter.textContent = `(${userData.colors.length}/5)`;
            counter.style.cssText = 'font-size: 12px; color: #888; margin-left: auto;';
            colorWrap.appendChild(counter);
        };
        renderPalette();
        modal.appendChild(colorWrap);

        const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
        textarea.value = userData.notes || '';
        textarea.placeholder = 'Общий текст заметки (например: спамер)';
        textarea.style.cssText = 'width: 100%; height: 50px; margin-bottom: 15px; padding: 8px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid #444; border-radius: 4px; resize: vertical; background: #2a2a2a; color: #fff; font-family: inherit;';
        modal.appendChild(textarea);

        const linksTitle = document.createElement('div');
        linksTitle.textContent = 'Ссылки на контент:';
        linksTitle.style.cssText = 'font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 5px; font-size: 14px;';
        modal.appendChild(linksTitle);

        const linksContainer = document.createElement('div');
        linksContainer.style.cssText = 'max-height: 120px; overflow-y: auto; margin-bottom: 10px; border: 1px solid #333; border-radius: 4px; padding: 5px; background: #181818;';
        
        const renderLinks = () => {
            linksContainer.innerHTML = '';
            if (userData.links.length === 0) {
                linksContainer.innerHTML = '<div style="color: #666; font-size: 12px; text-align: center; padding: 10px 0;">Нет добавленных ссылок</div>';
                return;
            }
            userData.links.forEach((linkObj, index) => {
                const linkRow = document.createElement('div');
                linkRow.style.cssText = 'display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 6px; background: #2a2a2a; padding: 6px; border-radius: 3px; border-left: 2px solid #3498db;';
                
                const textWrap = document.createElement('div');
                textWrap.style.cssText = 'display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; max-width: 290px;';
                
                const a = document.createElement('a');
                a.href = linkObj.url;
                a.target = '_blank';
                a.textContent = linkObj.url;
                a.style.cssText = 'color: #3498db; text-decoration: none; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;';
                textWrap.appendChild(a);
                
                if (linkObj.desc) {
                    const descSpan = document.createElement('span');
                    descSpan.textContent = linkObj.desc;
                    descSpan.style.cssText = 'color: #aaa; font-size: 11px; font-style: italic; margin-top: 2px;';
                    textWrap.appendChild(descSpan);
                }

                const delBtn = document.createElement('button');
                delBtn.textContent = '✖';
                delBtn.style.cssText = 'background: none; border: none; color: #e74c3c; cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px; padding: 0 5px; margin-left: 5px;';
                delBtn.onclick = () => { userData.links.splice(index, 1); renderLinks(); };
                
                linkRow.appendChild(textWrap);
                linkRow.appendChild(delBtn);
                linksContainer.appendChild(linkRow);
            });
        };
        renderLinks();
        modal.appendChild(linksContainer);

        const linkInputWrap = document.createElement('div');
        linkInputWrap.style.cssText = 'display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; margin-bottom: 15px; background: #252525; padding: 10px; border-radius: 4px;';
        
        const linkUrlInput = document.createElement('input');
        linkUrlInput.type = 'text';
        linkUrlInput.placeholder = 'Ссылка (https://pikabu.ru/story/...)';
        linkUrlInput.style.cssText = 'width: 100%; padding: 5px; border: 1px solid #444; border-radius: 4px; background: #1e1e1e; color: #fff; font-size: 12px; box-sizing: border-box;';

        const linkDescInput = document.createElement('input');
        linkDescInput.type = 'text';
        linkDescInput.placeholder = 'Описание (например: пост со спамом)';
        linkDescInput.style.cssText = 'width: 100%; padding: 5px; border: 1px solid #444; border-radius: 4px; background: #1e1e1e; color: #fff; font-size: 12px; box-sizing: border-box;';
        
        const addLinkBtn = document.createElement('button');
        addLinkBtn.textContent = 'Добавить ссылку в список';
        addLinkBtn.style.cssText = 'width: 100%; padding: 6px; cursor: pointer; background: #3498db; color: white; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;';
        
        const doAddLink = () => {
            const url = linkUrlInput.value.trim();
            const desc = linkDescInput.value.trim();
            if (url) {
                userData.links.push({ url: url, desc: desc });
                linkUrlInput.value = '';
                linkDescInput.value = '';
                renderLinks();
            }
        };

        addLinkBtn.onclick = doAddLink;
        linkDescInput.onkeypress = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') doAddLink(); };
        
        linkInputWrap.appendChild(linkUrlInput);
        linkInputWrap.appendChild(linkDescInput);
        linkInputWrap.appendChild(addLinkBtn);
        modal.appendChild(linkInputWrap);

        const actionWrap = document.createElement('div');
        actionWrap.style.cssText = 'display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 10px;';
        
        const cancelBtn = document.createElement('button');
        cancelBtn.textContent = 'Отмена';
        cancelBtn.style.cssText = 'padding: 5px 15px; cursor: pointer; background: #444; color: white; border: none; border-radius: 4px;';
        cancelBtn.onclick = () => { modal.remove(); overlay.remove(); };
        
        const saveBtn = document.createElement('button');
        saveBtn.textContent = 'Сохранить заметку';
        saveBtn.style.cssText = 'padding: 5px 15px; cursor: pointer; background: #2ecc71; color: white; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: bold;';
        saveBtn.onclick = () => {
            db[username] = { colors: userData.colors, notes: textarea.value.trim(), links: userData.links };
            if (db[username].colors.length === 0 && !db[username].notes && db[username].links.length === 0) delete db[username];
            saveDb();
            updateAllMarkers();
            modal.remove(); overlay.remove();
        };
        
        actionWrap.appendChild(cancelBtn);
        actionWrap.appendChild(saveBtn);
        modal.appendChild(actionWrap);

        const overlay = document.createElement('div');
        overlay.id = 'custom-note-overlay';
        overlay.style.cssText = 'position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7); z-index: 99998;';
        overlay.onclick = () => { modal.remove(); overlay.remove(); };
        
        document.body.appendChild(overlay);
        document.body.appendChild(modal);
    }

    function openGlobalSettings() {
        const existingModal = document.getElementById('custom-settings-modal');
        if (existingModal) existingModal.remove();
        const existingOverlay = document.getElementById('custom-settings-overlay');
        if (existingOverlay) existingOverlay.remove();

        const modal = document.createElement('div');
        modal.id = 'custom-settings-modal';
        modal.style.cssText = `position: fixed; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); background: #1e1e1e; color: #fff; padding: 20px; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); z-index: 99999; width: 300px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; border: 1px solid #444;`;

        const header = document.createElement('h3');
        header.textContent = `Описания цветов`;
        header.style.cssText = 'margin-top: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #444; padding-bottom: 10px; font-size: 16px;';
        modal.appendChild(header);

        const descWrap = document.createElement('div');
        descWrap.style.cssText = 'max-height: 300px; overflow-y: auto; margin-bottom: 15px;';
        
        Object.keys(COLORS).forEach(c => {
            const row = document.createElement('div');
            row.style.cssText = 'display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 8px;';
            const dot = document.createElement('div');
            dot.style.cssText = `width: 15px; height: 15px; border-radius: 50%; background: ${COLORS[c]}; flex-shrink: 0;`;
            const input = document.createElement('input');
            input.type = 'text';
            input.value = colorDescs[c] || '';
            input.placeholder = c;
            input.style.cssText = 'flex-grow: 1; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid #444; border-radius: 4px; background: #2a2a2a; color: #fff; font-size: 12px;';
            input.oninput = (e) => { colorDescs[c] = e.target.value.trim(); };
            row.appendChild(dot);
            row.appendChild(input);
            descWrap.appendChild(row);
        });
        modal.appendChild(descWrap);

        const actionWrap = document.createElement('div');
        actionWrap.style.cssText = 'display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 10px;';
        const cancelBtn = document.createElement('button');
        cancelBtn.textContent = 'Отмена';
        cancelBtn.style.cssText = 'padding: 5px 15px; cursor: pointer; background: #444; color: white; border: none; border-radius: 4px;';
        cancelBtn.onclick = () => { modal.remove(); overlay.remove(); };
        const saveBtn = document.createElement('button');
        saveBtn.textContent = 'Сохранить';
        saveBtn.style.cssText = 'padding: 5px 15px; cursor: pointer; background: #2ecc71; color: white; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: bold;';
        saveBtn.onclick = () => { saveColorDescs(); updateAllMarkers(); modal.remove(); overlay.remove(); };
        actionWrap.appendChild(cancelBtn);
        actionWrap.appendChild(saveBtn);
        modal.appendChild(actionWrap);

        const overlay = document.createElement('div');
        overlay.id = 'custom-settings-overlay';
        overlay.style.cssText = 'position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7); z-index: 99998;';
        overlay.onclick = () => { modal.remove(); overlay.remove(); };
        
        document.body.appendChild(overlay);
        document.body.appendChild(modal);
    }

    function createMarker(username) {
        const userData = db[username] || { colors: [], notes: '', links: [] };
        const marker = document.createElement('span');
        marker.className = 'custom-user-marker';
        marker.style.cssText = 'display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; gap: 2px; cursor: pointer; margin: 0 4px; vertical-align: middle; padding: 2px; transition: all 0.2s; border-radius: 4px;';
        
        const hasColors = userData.colors && userData.colors.length > 0;
        const hasNotes = userData.notes && userData.notes.trim().length > 0;

        if (!hasColors && !hasNotes) {
            marker.style.opacity = '0.2';
            marker.onmouseenter = () => marker.style.opacity = '1';
            marker.onmouseleave = () => marker.style.opacity = '0.2';
            marker.innerHTML = '<span style="font-size: 14px;">📝</span>';
        } else {
            marker.style.opacity = '1';
            if (hasColors) {
                userData.colors.forEach(c => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('span');
                    dot.style.cssText = `display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: ${COLORS[c]}; box-shadow: 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);`;
                    dot.title = colorDescs[c] ? colorDescs[c] : c; 
                    marker.appendChild(dot);
                });
            } else if (hasNotes) {
                marker.innerHTML = '<span style="font-size: 14px;">📝</span>';
            }
        }

        if (userData.links && userData.links.length > 0) {
            const linkCount = document.createElement('span');
            linkCount.textContent = `[${userData.links.length}]`;
            linkCount.style.cssText = 'font-size: 10px; margin-left: 3px; color: #888; font-weight: bold;';
            marker.appendChild(linkCount);
        }

        marker.title = userData.notes || 'Добавить заметку';
        marker.onclick = (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            openNoteModal(username);
        };

        return marker;
    }

    function updateAllMarkers() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.comment__user').forEach(el => {
            let username = el.getAttribute('data-name');
            const nickEl = el.querySelector('.user__nick');
            if (!username && nickEl) {
                const href = nickEl.getAttribute('href');
                if (href && href.includes('/@')) username = href.split('@')[1].split('?')[0];
            }
            if (!username || username === 'DELETED' || username === 'Аноним') return;
            
            if (nickEl) {
                if (!nickEl.nextElementSibling?.classList.contains('custom-user-marker')) {
                    const marker = createMarker(username);
                    if (marker) { nickEl.after(marker); }
                }
            } else {
                if (!el.lastElementChild?.classList.contains('custom-user-marker')) {
                     const marker = createMarker(username);
                     if (marker) { el.appendChild(marker); }
                }
            }
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('.story__user-link, .story__author').forEach(el => {
            let username = el.getAttribute('data-name');
            if (!username) {
                const href = el.getAttribute('href');
                if (href && href.includes('/@')) username = href.split('@')[1].split('?')[0];
            }
            if (!username || username === 'DELETED' || username === 'Аноним') return;

            if (!el.nextElementSibling?.classList.contains('custom-user-marker')) {
                const marker = createMarker(username);
                if (marker) { el.after(marker); }
            }
        });
        
        const profileHeader = document.querySelector('.profile__nick');
        if (profileHeader) {
             let username = window.location.href.split('@')[1]?.split('/')[0]?.split('?')[0];
             if (username && !profileHeader.nextElementSibling?.classList.contains('custom-user-marker')) {
                 const marker = createMarker(username);
                 if (marker) { profileHeader.after(marker); }
             }
        }
    }

    function createSettingsButton() {
        if (document.getElementById('custom-settings-btn')) return;
        const btn = document.createElement('div');
        btn.id = 'custom-settings-btn';
        btn.innerHTML = '⚙️';
        btn.title = 'Настройки цветов Notes_OldReact_Pikabu';
        btn.style.cssText = `position: fixed; bottom: 80px; right: 20px; background: #1e1e1e; border: 1px solid #444; color: #fff; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; font-size: 20px; z-index: 99990; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); transition: 0.2s;`;
        btn.onmouseenter = () => btn.style.background = '#333';
        btn.onmouseleave = () => btn.style.background = '#1e1e1e';
        btn.onclick = openGlobalSettings;
        document.body.appendChild(btn);
    }

    injectReactionReplacements();
    updateAllMarkers();
    createSettingsButton();

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldUpdate = false;
        for (const mutation of mutations) {
            for (const node of mutation.addedNodes) {
                if (node.nodeType === 1) { 
                    if (node.classList.contains('comment__header') || node.classList.contains('story') || node.classList.contains('comment')) {
                        shouldUpdate = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (shouldUpdate) break;
        }
        if (shouldUpdate) setTimeout(updateAllMarkers, 200); 
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
})();
